taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-15 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1132.2 | 7.42 | 7.42
2 | 3621.5 | 17.67 | 25.09
3 | 4447.9 | 1.70 | 26.79
4 | 4307.5 | 0.53 | 27.32
5 | 7664.9 | 4.92 | 32.24
6 | 12762.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HKHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-15
Curve type: HKHA
Aquifer depth: 25.09 – 27.32 m
Recommendation: This interval corresponds to the H-segment of the curve (Layer 4, 4307.5 ohm-m), a thin resistivity low sandwiched between higher-resistivity units, consistent with a fractured/weathered zone in the basement sequence. Drill through this horizon with continuous sampling and consider light-duty testing, as the zone is thin (~0.5 m) and may offer only limited yield; deepen the borehole into Layer 5/6 if confirmation of water strike is inconclusive.
